entries.summary: Bertold von Zwingenberg verpflichtet sich, wieder im Schloß Lichteneck bei Ingelfingen sich zu stellen; Siegel: Bertold von Zwingenberg und Eberhard von Rosenberg (Duplikat).
entries.german:
Ich Berthold von Zwingenberg der knecht bekenne offenlich an disem briefe vnd tun kunt allen den die in sehent
oder horent lesen / daz ich gevangen bin mines herren / hern Kraften von Hohenlach dez alten / vnd sin erben / vnd vmb die
[…] hat er mir tag gebin / biz uf den wissen suntag der nehst kumpt / daz ich mich sal stellen / den Lichtenecke [?]
[…] nummer ze komen ich sie dan behalten vor in den handen / da ich vor inne bin gewesen on alle gnade / vnd auch
[…] sin wile vnd sin wort / oder sin erben […] wes daz man min […]
hern Kraft von Hohenlach der vorgenant / so hat er mich gemanet in Eberhartes hus von Rosinberg / dez […] ich
[…] die manunge tut mit sinen briuen oder mit sinen boten / so sol ich mich dan nach stellen in vierzehen [?]
tagen den Lichtenecke [?] / in alle wise als vorgeschriben stet / on alle gnade / vnd han dez zu den heyligen gesworn
stet ze halten an alle gnade / ze vrkunde vnd sicherheit aller vorgeschribener rede / han ich min eygen Insigel
gehenket an disen brief / vnd zu einer besern gezugnisse han ich gebetten hern Wiprechten von Dürn […] daz er sin Insigel […]
[…] hat gehenket an disem brief / Ich Wiprecht von Dürn vorgenant bekenne daz ich durch
bette willen dez vorgenanten Berthold von Zwingenberg / min Insigel zu sinem han gehenket an disen brief / der
geben wart do man zalt von Cristes geburte / drizehenhundert iar / vnd dar nach in dem fünf vnd sechzigsten
iare an dem nehsten Samstage vor sant Gregorien tag
entries.english:
I, Berthold von Zwingenberg, the Knecht, publicly declare in this letter and make known to all who see
or hear it read that I am a prisoner of my lord, Lord Kraft von Hohenlohe the Elder, and his heirs, and concerning the
[…] he has given me a term until the coming White Sunday, by which I shall present myself [at Lichteneck [?]]
[…] never to come [?], unless I am held in the hands in which I was before, without mercy, and also
[…] his will and his word, or his heirs […] whatever my lord […]
the aforesaid Lord Kraft von Hohenlohe, then he has summoned me to the house of Eberhard von Rosenberg […] I
[…] makes the summons with his letters or with his messengers, then I shall present myself within fourteen [?]
days at Lichteneck [?], in every way as written above, without mercy, and I have sworn this on the saints
to keep without mercy. In witness and assurance of all the aforesaid, I have attached my own seal
to this letter, and for better testimony I have asked Lord Wiprecht von Dürn […] that he […] seal
[…] has attached to this letter. I, the aforesaid Wiprecht von Dürn, declare that, at the
request of the aforesaid Berthold von Zwingenberg, I have attached my seal to his to this letter. This was
given when one counted from Christ’s birth thirteen hundred years and thereafter in the sixty-fifth year, on the next Saturday before St. Gregory’s day.

facts.content: was held prisoner by Kraft von Hohenlohe the Elder and his heirs.
promised to present himself at Lichteneck by the coming Weißer Sonntag.
promised to present himself at Lichteneck within fourteen days [?] of a summons by letter or messenger from Kraft von Hohenlohe.
swore on the saints to keep his undertaking.
had his house named as the place where Kraft von Hohenlohe could summon Berthold von Zwingenberg.
sealed Berthold von Zwingenberg’s undertaking at his request.
